Référence 5875904
|
Créé le 18 juin 2026
Retour à la liste
Temps de travail :
Temps plein
Type de contrat :
Durée indéterminée
Famille de métiers :
Informatique / Services informatiques
Nombre d'années d'expérience :
Minimum 3 ans d'expérience
Description de la fonction
Turn complex data into clear business decisions. Be the bridge between insight and action in a dynamic hybrid international environment.
We're looking for a passionate
BI Analyst & Automation Specialist
who thrives at the intersection of
data, automation, and business transformation
. You enjoy turning complex processes into smart digital solutions and leveraging technology to create measurable business impact.
BI Analyst & Automation Specialist - The Role
Design and develop
automated workflows, business applications, and data solutions
using Python and the Microsoft Power Platform
Analyze manual processes and transform them into efficient, scalable, and reliable digital workflows
Build integrations between applications and data sources through
APIs
and the Microsoft ecosystem
Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities, define requirements, and deliver innovative solutions that drive operational excellence
Lead and support automation initiatives while ensuring high standards in
testing, documentation, governance, security, and continuous improvement
Profil
BI Analyst & Automation Specialist - The Profile
Bachelor's or Master's degree in
Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
Strong knowledge of
Python, SQL, Linux, Power Apps, and Power Automate
Experience with data analysis, process automation, and business application development
Excellent analytical mindset, attention to detail, and ability to translate business needs into scalable solutions
Fluent in
Dutch
and comfortable working in an international environment where
English
is the common language
Compétences linguistiques
Néérlandais (atout)
Comprendre : Elémentaire (A)
Écrire : Elémentaire (A)
Lire : Elémentaire (A)
Parler : Elémentaire (A)
Avantages du poste
BI Analyst & Automation Specialist - The Offer & Advantages
A highly visible role with direct impact on business performance and digital transformation
Exposure to
modern technologies, trainings
Collaboration with local and international teams, providing a truly global perspective
Competitive salary, annual bonus and several advantages
Continuous learning opportunities, professional growth, and the freedom to take ownership of projects
